title: Are There Strangers in Space?
question: What does the 'uniquely rational way' for us to communicate with other intelligent beings in space depend on?

meanings.usage: 用来描述基于逻辑思考而非情绪的判断、行为等
用于修饰数量、程度等，表不十分精确的估算

meanings.meaning: 普遍的；盛行的；当时存在的
meanings.usage: 用来描述某一时期最常见、占主导的情况或现象
常用于be bound to结构，表确定性极强的推断
指对数量、价值等做出大致的判断，常用于被动语态be estimated at
后常接介词to，表示“对…的阻碍”

meanings.meaning: 天文学的；天文的；极其巨大的
meanings.usage: 既可修饰和天文相关的事物，也可夸张地形容数量、数值极大
常指气体、辐射、信号等的释放，后可接介词of
用于修饰太空里恒星之间的事物，如interstellar communication星际通讯
可指预先约定的会面，也可指约定的会面地点，正式用法
用来修饰行为、状态等，强调其不合理、可笑的程度

phrases.usage: 表达对某事发生的确定性推断，语气十分肯定，相当于“一定会，必定会”

examples.en: If you work hard, you are bound to make progress sooner or later.
examples.zh: 如果你努力，迟早一定会取得进步。

examples.en: There are bound to be unexpected difficulties when starting a new project.
examples.zh: 启动新项目时一定会遇到意料之外的困难。

phrases.usage: 表示意外遇到困难、问题、反对等，主语通常是人或组织

examples.en: We came up against a lack of funds when trying to expand the business.
examples.zh: 我们试图拓展业务时遇到了资金短缺的问题。

examples.en: Many new graduates come up against fierce competition in the job market.
examples.zh: 很多应届毕业生在就业市场遇到了激烈的竞争。

phrases.usage: 用于进一步否定或强调更不可能的情况，通常前面是否定句，相当于“更不用说”

examples.en: I can't even afford a cheap bicycle, let alone a car.
examples.zh: 我连便宜的自行车都买不起，更不用说汽车了。

examples.en: He can't speak basic Japanese, let alone read Japanese novels.
examples.zh: 他连基础日语都不会说，更不用说读日语小说了。

phrases.usage: 表示“取决于；依赖；依靠”，后可接名词、代词或从句

examples.en: The success of the activity depends on the weather.
examples.zh: 活动能否成功取决于天气。

examples.en: You should not always depend on others when you meet problems.
examples.zh: 遇到问题时你不要总依赖别人。

phrases.usage: 此处含义为“接收到（信号、声音、图像等）”，此外还有“捡起；接人；学会”等含义

examples.en: My radio can pick up international stations very clearly.
examples.zh: 我的收音机可以非常清晰地接收国际电台。

examples.en: The equipment picked up a strange signal from outer space.
examples.zh: 这台设备接收到了一个来自外太空的奇怪信号。

sentences.en: We must conclude from the work of those who have studied the origin of life,
sentences.zh: 从研究生命起源的那些人的工作中，我们必须得出结论，

sentences.en: that given a planet only approximately like our own, life is almost certain to start.
sentences.zh: 只要有一颗与我们地球大致相似的行星，生命几乎肯定会开始。

sentences.en: Of all the planets in our solar system, we are now pretty certain the Earth is the only one on which life can survive.
sentences.zh: 在我们太阳系的所有行星中，我们现在非常确定地球是唯一一个生命可以存活的行星。

sentences.en: Mars is too dry and poor in oxygen, Venus far too hot, and so is Mercury,
sentences.zh: 火星太干燥，氧气稀少；金星和水星都太热，

sentences.en: and the outer planets have temperatures near absolute zero and hydrogen-dominated atmospheres.
sentences.zh: 而外行星的温度接近绝对零度，大气层以氢为主。

sentences.en: But other suns, start as the astronomers call them, are bound to have planets like our own, and as is the number of stars in the universe is so vast,
sentences.zh: 但是其他太阳，天文学家称之为恒星，必定有像我们地球一样的行星，而且宇宙中恒星的数量如此之多，

sentences.en: this possibility becomes virtual certainty.
sentences.zh: 这种可能性几乎成了必然。

sentences.en: There are one hundred thousand million starts in our own Milky Way alone,
sentences.zh: 仅在我们的银河系中就有1000亿颗恒星，

sentences.en: and then there are three thousand million other milky ways or galaxies, in the universe.
sentences.zh: 而宇宙中还有30亿个其他星系。

sentences.en: so the number of stars that we know exist is now estimated at about 300 million million million.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们已知存在的恒星数量现在估计约为300万亿亿。

sentences.en: Although perhaps only 1 percent of the life that has started somewhere will develop into highly complex and intelligent patterns,
sentences.zh: 尽管在某个地方开始的生命中，可能只有1%会发展成高度复杂和智能的模式，

sentences.en: so vast is the number of planets, that intelligent life is bound to be a natural part of the universe.
sentences.zh: 但行星的数量如此之多，以至于智慧生命必然是宇宙的自然组成部分。

sentences.en: If then we are so certain that other intelligent life exists in the universe, why have we had no visitors from outer space yet?
sentences.zh: 既然我们如此确定宇宙中存在其他智慧生命，那为什么我们还没有迎来外太空的访客呢？

sentences.en: First of all, they may have come to this planet of ours thousands or millions of years ago,
sentences.zh: 首先，他们可能在几千或几百万年前就已经来到过我们的星球，

sentences.en: and found our then prevailing primitive state completely uninteresting to their own advanced knowledge.
sentences.zh: 并发现我们当时普遍存在的原始状态对于他们自身先进的知识来说完全不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Professor Ronald Bracewell, a leading American radio astronomer,
sentences.zh: 罗纳德·布雷斯韦尔教授，一位杰出的美国射电天文学家，

sentences.en: argued in Nature that such a superior civilization, on a visit to our own solar system,
sentences.zh: 在《自然》杂志上提出，这样一个更高级的文明，在访问我们太阳系时，

sentences.en: may have left an automatic messenger behind to await the possible awakening of an advanced civilization.
sentences.zh: 可能会留下一个自动信使，以等待一个先进文明的可能觉醒。

sentences.en: Such a messenger, receiving our radio and television signals,
sentences.zh: 这样一个信使，在接收到我们的无线电和电视信号后，

sentences.en: might well re-transmit them back to its home-planet,
sentences.zh: 很可能会将它们重新发送回它的母星，

sentences.en: although what impression any other civilization would thus get from us is best left unsaid.
sentences.zh: 尽管其他文明会因此从我们这里得到什么样的印象最好还是不提为妙。

sentences.en: But here we come up against the most difficult of all obstacles to contact with people on other planets
sentences.zh: 但在这里，我们遇到了与外星球人接触所有障碍中最困难的一个

sentences.en: -- the astronomical distances which separate us.
sentences.zh: ——将我们分开的巨大天文距离。

sentences.en: As a reasonable guess, they might, on an average, be 100 light years away.
sentences.zh: 合理猜测，他们平均可能在100光年之外。

sentences.en: (A light year is the distance which light travels at 186,000 miles per second in one year, namely 6 million million miles.)
sentences.zh: (一光年是光以每秒18.6万英里的速度在一年中旅行的距离，即6万亿英里。)

sentences.en: Radio waves also travel at the speed of light,
sentences.zh: 无线电波也以光速传播，

sentences.en: and assuming such an automatic messenger picked up our first broadcasts of the 1920's,
sentences.zh: 假设这样一个自动信使接收到了我们20世纪20年代的首次广播，

sentences.en: the message to its home planet is barely halfway there.
sentences.zh: 那么它传回家园星球的信息才刚刚走了一半的路程。

sentences.en: Similarly, our own present primitive chemical rockets,
sentences.zh: 同样地，我们目前原始的化学火箭，

sentences.en: though good enough to orbit men, have no chance of transporting us to the nearest other star,
sentences.zh: 尽管足以将人类送入轨道，却没有机会将我们运送到最近的恒星，

sentences.en: four light years away, let alone distances of tens or hundreds of light years.
sentences.zh: 距我们四光年之遥，更不用说几十或几百光年的距离了。

sentences.en: Fortunately, there is a 'uniquely rational way' for us to communicate with other intelligent beings,
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，我们有一种“唯一理性方式”可以与其他智慧生物交流，

sentences.en: as Walter Sullivan has put it in his excellent book,
sentences.zh: 正如沃尔特·沙利文在他的优秀著作中所说，

sentences.en: We Are not Alone.
sentences.zh: 《我们并不孤单》。

sentences.en: This depends on the precise radio frequency of the 21-cm wavelength, or 1420 megacycles per second.
sentences.zh: 这取决于21厘米波长，即每秒1420兆赫兹的精确无线电频率。

sentences.en: It is the natural frequency of emission of the hydrogen atoms in space and was discovered by us in 1951;
sentences.zh: 它是太空中氢原子的自然发射频率，由我们于1951年发现；

sentences.en: it must be known to any kind of radio astronomer in the universe.
sentences.zh: 宇宙中任何一种射电天文学家都必定知道它。

sentences.en: Once the existence of this wave-length had been discovered,
sentences.zh: 一旦这种波长被发现，

sentences.en: it was not long before its use as the uniquely recognizable broadcasting frequency for interstellar communication was suggested.
sentences.zh: 很快就有人建议将其用作星际通信的独特可识别广播频率。

sentences.en: Without something of this kind,
sentences.zh: 如果没有这种东西，

sentences.en: searching for intelligences on other planets would be like trying to meet a friend in London without a pre-arranged rendezvous
sentences.zh: 寻找其他行星上的智慧生命，就像在伦敦没有事先约定地点就试图与朋友见面一样，

sentences.en: and absurdly wandering the streets in the hope of a chance encounter.
sentences.zh: 荒唐地在街上闲逛，希望能偶然相遇。

grammar.title: given引导的条件状语
grammar.definition: given作为介词，意为“考虑到；鉴于；如果有”，后接名词、代词或名词短语，可放在句首或句中，表前提条件
grammar.structure: Given + 名词/名词短语, 主句
grammar.usage: 用于引出某个既定的前提，基于这个前提得出主句的结论，属于书面正式用法

examples.en: Given a chance, I believe I can do the job well.
examples.zh: 如果有机会，我相信我能把这份工作做好。

examples.en: Given the current situation, we have to put off the meeting.
examples.zh: 考虑到目前的情况，我们不得不推迟会议。

grammar.title: so...that...引导的结果状语从句（倒装结构）
grammar.definition: 为了强调形容词或副词，可将so + 形容词/副词放在句首，此时主句需要部分倒装，that后的结果状语从句语序不变
grammar.structure: So + 形容词/副词 + 助动词/系动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 谓语剩余部分 + that + 结果状语从句
grammar.usage: 用于正式文体中，加强语气，突出主句中描述的特征的程度之深，进而导致了从句的结果

examples.en: So fast did he run that no one could catch up with him.
examples.zh: 他跑得太快了，没人能追上他。

examples.en: So attractive is the book that I have read it three times.
examples.zh: 这本书太有吸引力了，我已经读了三遍。

patterns.pattern: We must conclude from + 来源, that + 结论

original.en: We must conclude from the work of those who have studied the origin of life, that given a planet only approximately like our own, life is almost certain to start.
original.zh: 从那些研究生命起源的科学家的工作中我们必然会得出这样的结论：如果有一颗行星和地球的条件哪怕只是近似，生命就几乎肯定会起源。

examples.en: We must conclude from the recent surveys, that more and more young people prefer to work from home.
examples.zh: 从最近的调查中我们必然会得出结论：越来越多的年轻人倾向于居家办公。

examples.en: We must conclude from the data collected over the past decade, that global warming is speeding up.
examples.zh: 从过去十年收集的数据中我们必然会得出结论：全球变暖正在加速。

patterns.pattern: ..., why have we had + 名词 + yet?

original.en: If then we are so certain that other intelligent life exists in the universe, why have we had no visitors from outer space yet?
original.zh: 那么如果我们如此确定宇宙中存在其他智慧生命，为什么我们至今还没有迎来外太空的访客呢？

examples.en: If you said you would send me the document yesterday, why have we had no news from you yet?
examples.zh: 如果你说你昨天会把文件发给我，为什么我们至今还没有收到你的消息？

examples.en: If the project was supposed to be finished last month, why have we had no final report yet?
examples.zh: 如果这个项目本应该上个月就完成，为什么我们至今还没有看到最终报告？

patterns.pattern: Without something of this kind, doing sth would be like doing sth without...

original.en: Without something of this kind, searching for intelligences on other planets would be like trying to meet a friend in London without a pre-arranged rendezvous and absurdly wandering the streets in the hope of a chance encounter.
original.zh: 如果没有这种频率，寻找其他行星上的智慧生命就好比没有预先约定会面地点就试图在伦敦见一个朋友，荒唐地在街上游荡，希望能偶然碰见。

examples.en: Without a clear study plan, preparing for the exam would be like trying to find a destination in a forest without a map and walking aimlessly in the hope of finding the way out.
examples.zh: 如果没有清晰的学习计划，备考就好比没有地图就试图在森林里找目的地，漫无目的地行走，希望能找到出路。

examples.en: Without enough market research, launching a new product would be like trying to sail across the ocean without a compass and drifting randomly in the hope of reaching the port.
examples.zh: 如果没有足够的市场调研，推出新产品就好比没有指南针就试图横渡大洋，随意漂流，希望能抵达港口。
